يستظهر (form X)
# يَسْتَظْهِرُ (yastaẓhiru) /jas.taðˤ.hi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# يُسْتَظْهَرُ (yustaẓharu) /jus.taðˤ.ha.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# يَسْتَظْهِرَ (yastaẓhira) /jas.taðˤ.hi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَظْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
